_note: Scene select (dev tool, scripts/core/scene_presets.gd, menu scripts/view/scene_select.gd): jump straight to a story point. Shown while the debug overlay is on (debug builds, F3, three corner taps, ?debug=1): a 'Scene select' button on the title screen, F1 or the 'Scenes' debug button in the game. Each preset starts a new game, then sets: flags (GameState; 'base' = another preset whose flags come first), needs (hunger / thirst), time (time of day 0..1), story (Story.load_save_data: border_patrols), area + spawn (or pos + facing in that area), and optionally 'wake' (a strings.json key: arrive through a fade with that line on black, as if just waking). A new story point is one more line.
